title: Landing Zone Knowledge Base document front matter
description: JSON object that MUST be the first JSON object in each KB PDF/text document. The engine extracts this object, then parses markdown headings after it. Stream uses maturity/antipattern (not capability). Do not include legacy fields streams or antipattern_id.

kb_id.description: Stable document id. Example: lz-kb-A1-v1, lz-kb-AP-A1-v1.

version.description: Document version. Independent of pack version.

domain_name.description: Must match pack taxonomy name exactly, e.g. Tenant, billing & organization construct.

stream.description: Engine stream. Use maturity for capabilities A1–H5. Use antipattern for AP-A1–AP-H5. Do not use capability.

criterion_id.description: This document's criterion. Capability file: A1. Antipattern file: AP-A1.

capability_id.description: Paired capability id WITHOUT AP-. Always A1 on both the A1 and AP-A1 documents.

pair_id.description: Pack pair-registry id. PAIR-A1 pairs A1 with AP-A1.

intent_id.description: From the pack criterion record, e.g. authoritative-org-root.

capability_name.description: Required on maturity documents. Pack capability title.

antipattern_name.description: Required on antipattern documents. Pack anti-pattern title.
